other_failure_modes.name: Target Leakage in Rolling Features
other_failure_modes.description: Rolling features are computed on the target variable without shifting first. This means the current row's target value is included in the rolling mean/std calculation, allowing the model to perfectly 'predict' the target during training.

other_failure_modes.name: Invalid Multi-step Forecasting Lags
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes lag and rolling features for the test set by forward-filling the last known training target. For a block multi-step forecast, this makes all lag and rolling features constant (flat) for the entire test horizon, rendering them meaningless during inference.

summary: The agent implements a solid temporal validation split and extracts extensive features, but critically leaks the target variable into the training set by taking a rolling mean of the target without shifting. Furthermore, its strategy of forward-filling the target for test set lags results in completely flat, useless lag features for inference. It also uses naive ensembling and single evaluations of stochastic models.
